marketMood: Risk-off: Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole pivot sends September rate-hike odds above 60% while a fresh US strike near the Strait of Hormuz lifts Brent toward $90, weighing on global equities.

upcomingEvents.event: US Nonfarm Payrolls — August Jobs Report

topStories.headline: US Strikes Iranian Rocket Launchers Near Strait of Hormuz; Brent Crude Jumps 2% to ~$90
topStories.summary: US CENTCOM struck IRGC positions on Larak Island on Sunday after Revolutionary Guard forces were observed preparing sea mines to launch into the Strait of Hormuz — the first US military action in the region in a month.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent crude ↑ ~2% to ~$90/bbl; energy stocks ↑ (XOM, CVX, USO); broad equities ↓ on risk-off; watch tanker insurance premiums and shipping lane disruption

topStories.headline: Fed Chair Warsh's Hawkish Jackson Hole Speech Sends September Rate-Hike Odds Above 60%
topStories.summary: At Jackson Hole on Friday, Warsh called inflation progress insufficient and recommitted firmly to the 2% PCE target, pushing CME FedWatch odds for a September 25bp hike from ~35% before the speech to above 60% after.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ USD, ↑ 10Y Treasury yield (now 4.72%); ↓ rate-sensitive equities (REITs, utilities, growth tech); S&P 500 -0.25% Friday, Nasdaq -0.52%; watch SPY, QQQ, TLT

topStories.headline: Nvidia Posts Record $96.2B in Q2 Revenue; Data Center Doubles to $89B Year-on-Year
topStories.summary: Nvidia's Q2 FY27 report (released Aug 26) showed 106% year-on-year revenue growth driven by AI accelerator demand; CEO Jensen Huang guided for 70% revenue growth in FY28, and the stock added more than $400B in market cap.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ NVDA and AI supply chain (AMD, TSM); Nikkei chip names lifted Friday before reversing on Monday risk-off; watch if data center capex cycle sustains amid rate-hike fears

topStories.headline: China August Manufacturing PMI Edges Up to 49.8 — Second Consecutive Month of Contraction
topStories.summary: China's official NBS Manufacturing PMI rose from 49.2 in July to 49.8 in August, slightly beating the 49.7 forecast, but Non-Manufacturing PMI slipped to 49.0 and the Composite to 49.5, keeping pressure on Beijing for stimulus.
topStories.marketImpact: Mixed for HK equities (0700.HK, 9988.HK, FXI); manufacturing slight beat offsets services weakness; Beijing under pressure to announce fresh fiscal support

topStories.headline: Japan July Unemployment Falls to 12-Month Low of 2.4%; Tokyo Core CPI Rises to 1.8%
topStories.summary: Japan's unemployment fell to 2.4% in July and Tokyo's core CPI rose to 1.8% in August, approaching the BoJ's 2% target and cementing expectations for two more rate hikes before year-end.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ JPY (watch BoJ intervention risk near USD/JPY 160); ↓ Japanese exporters and automakers (7203.T); BoJ policy rate at 1.0%, two more 25bp hikes priced by year-end

topStories.headline: Nikkei 225 Drops 2.26% to 64,905 as Hormuz Escalation and Fed Hawkishness Hit Asia
topStories.summary: Japan's benchmark index shed 2.26% on August 30 as the dual headwinds of Warsh's hawkish remarks and the renewed US-Iran Strait of Hormuz escalation drove broad selling across Asian markets.
topStories.marketImpact: ↓ Japanese equities broadly; automakers and tech exporters most exposed (7203.T, 6758.T); yen appreciation risk compounds pressure on exporters; Topix also lower

topStories.headline: Chinese Hyperscalers Race to Build AI Data Centers Across Southeast Asia
topStories.summary: Alibaba, ByteDance-backed entities, and other Chinese cloud operators are rapidly expanding data center capacity in Malaysia, Thailand, and Indonesia, seeking faster construction and a foothold in booming regional AI markets.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ ASEAN real estate and power infrastructure; watch 9988.HK and 0700.HK for AI cloud revenue upside; mild positive for regional data center and utilities plays
